stable.notes: Fix Jobs.cz microsite email autofill by adding semantic email-field detection using labels, placeholders, aria metadata and nearby field text. Diagnostics now include the email field source. Manual queue behavior and manual final Submit safety remain unchanged.

beta.notes: Desktop 2.7.2 hardens Indeed discovery and cleans StartupJobs previews. Browser evidence now detects Access Denied/CAPTCHA/security-challenge pages and refuses to overwrite a real vacancy title, company, location, description, or evidence with block-page content. Indeed discovery also performs an early semantic dedupe across duplicate jk variants before enrichment. StartupJobs search-card headings are split conservatively so company, salary, work-mode and location badges no longer pollute the vacancy title in discovery preview. StartupJobs.cz and Indeed.cz remain discovery-only; application preparation and final submission behavior are unchanged.
